title: Personal tasks on a map
description: To-dos stay next to the projects and the links they came out of.

blocks.text: A linear list does not always explain why a task is there and what it depends on. On a map that context can be kept.

quote.text: i have such a hard time organizing my tasks and figuring it what order to do them in because of my adhd. I decided to try mind mapping, and i NEEDED something that worked on my ipad

blocks.text: Add a due date and a state to the nodes you choose while keeping the overview of all the branches. Show the next actions without rearranging the whole map.
Test how convenient it is on a small personal project. Reminders and filters should help choose an action, not turn the map into a complicated management system.
